extracted.name: Chicken Kabobs
extracted.description: Our easy Chicken Kabobs recipe is quick and flavorful made with juicy marinated chicken and colorful veggies.
ingredient_lines: 1/2 cup oil ( avocado or canola oil (120 mL))
1 teaspoon horseradish (, plain or horseradish sauce)
2 pounds boneless skinless chicken breasts ((907 g), or chicken tenders, cut into 1'' chunks)
2 bell peppers (,any color, sliced into large chunks)
1 sweet onion (,or purple onion, sliced into large chunks)
instruction_lines: Marinade: Add soy sauce, oil, sprite, garlic powder and horseradish to a large ziplock bag.
Assembly: Cut the chicken into 1-inch chunks and add it to the marinade. Marinate for 1-3 hours.

Skewer: If using bamboo skewers, soak them in water for 30 minutes (this will help keep them from burning while cooking on the grill). Thread the chicken and chopped vegetables alternately onto the skewers, keeping a little space between each piece.

Grill: Heat grill to medium-high and grease lightly with oil. Grill the kebabs for just a few minutes on each side (about 5 minutes), until chicken pieces are cooked through. Allow the kebabs to rest for 5 minutes before serving.
categories: How long to grill chicken kabobs
